$comment: Project-scoped MCP servers. These do NOT belong in .claude/settings.json --
settings.json has no mcpServers key, so a server declared there is silently
ignored. Project scope is .mcp.json (this file); user scope is ~/.claude.json.
Committing .mcp.json shares the server config with everyone on the project;
the DATABASE_URL is read from the environment so the secret is not committed
NOTE on the package: @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres is one of the
original reference servers. It still installs, but npm marks it deprecated
It is used here because the lab is about the CONFIG SHAPE, and that shape is
the same for any stdio server. For real work, pick a maintained community
Postgres server -- and expect this to keep churning. Reference servers get
archived as vendors ship their own: the GitHub server is now a container
from GitHub (ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server), not an npm package at all.
